Intro / Outro: C G C F C G a F

{C}All that I {G}have is a {F}river
The {a}river is always my {E}home
Lord, {C}take me a{F}way for I {a}just cannot {F}stay
Or I'll {C}sink in my {d}skin and my {F}bones

The {C}water su{G}stains me with{C}out even {F}trying
The {C}water can't {G}drown me, I'm {a}done
With my {F}dyy{C}ing

Please help me build a small boat
One that'll ride on the flow
Where the river runs deep, and the larger fish creep
I'm glad of what keeps me afloat

Now deeper the water I sail
And faster the current I'm in
But each night brings the stars
And the song in my heart 
Is a tune for the journeyman's tale

Now the {E}land that I knew is a {a}dream
And the {E}line on the distance grows {a}faint
So {C}wide is my {d}river, the ho{C}rizon a {d}sliver
The {C}artist has {G}run out of {F}paint

Where the blue of the sea meets the sky
And the big yellow sun leads me home
I'm everywhere now, the way is a vow
To the wind of each breath by and by
title: The Water
